name: Simmons University
description: Join a dynamic community of strong women leaders at Simmons, a private, liberal arts university located in central Boston. Simmons’ women-centered undergraduate education offers small class sizes, generous scholarships, and a supportive alumni network, to help you build a meaningful life and a successful career.
